sql: SELECT name, type FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY name;
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('items_g2','fdbk_g2');

rows:
CREATE TABLE items_g2 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    prc INTEGER,
    prc_usd REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    feat_lst TEXT,
    img_ct INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_g2 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id TEXT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts INTEGER,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g2(ref_id)
)

sql: SELECT 'g1' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY g, n DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer FROM (SELECT i.ref_id FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 GROUP BY i.ref_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=5 AND AVG(f.rtg)<3.0);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_items_avg FROM (SELECT i.ref_id FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 GROUP BY i.ref_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=5 AND i.avg_rtg<3.0);

SELECT i.ref_id, i.avg_rtg, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(f.rtg),3) avg_calc, i.prc_usd FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 GROUP BY i.ref_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=5 AND AVG(f.rtg)<3.0 ORDER BY avg_calc;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer_cents FROM (SELECT i.ref_id FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc>5000 GROUP BY i.ref_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=5 AND AVG(f.rtg)<3.0);
